# Delora

> Delora provides non-custodial infrastructure for moving and converting digital assets across supported networks. Businesses can integrate through an API, a customizable React widget, or an MCP server for AI tools.

Delora does not hold users' digital assets or private keys. Transactions are authorized through the user's or business's wallet and may involve third-party services. Asset, network, and route availability depends on the transaction. Delora does not provide bank accounts or fiat conversion; those services require separate providers or partners.

The Delora MCP server exposes read-only tools for discovery and quotes. It does not sign or broadcast transactions. A wallet or backend must sign and submit the unsigned transaction data returned by a quote.

## Product

- [Delora overview](https://delora.build/): Stablecoin infrastructure and supported business flows.
- [Product](https://delora.build/product/): Stablecoin movement, integrations, and transaction control.
- [Wallets](https://delora.build/use-cases/wallets/): Swaps and transfers within wallet applications.
- [Neobanks](https://delora.build/use-cases/neobanks/): Stablecoin account funding, transfers, and conversions.
- [Payments](https://delora.build/use-cases/payments/): Stablecoin payments, payouts, and conversion.
- [Pricing](https://delora.build/pricing/): Pricing and integration options.

- [Fee configuration](https://docs.delora.build/protocol/fee-configuration): Integrator attribution and fee settings.
